$comment: The WebGL methods of Khronos's IDL (contracts/runtime/webgl-idl/) that the facade does not define yet, grouped by why.
scripts/test-webgl-spec-surface-contract.sh fails when an IDL method is neither defined nor listed here, and when a listed one is defined.

unimplemented_methods.reason: `drawingBufferStorage` is a recent addition to the WebGL 2 interface that browsers do not ship; recorded so the list is the whole difference from the IDL, not a judgement that it will be written.
